mechanism.claim: When six liquid alt perpetuals realize unusually similar six-hour path variation, the volatility impulse is broad rather than concentrated in one speculative name. During elevated BTC variation, agreement between the alt final-hour majority and BTC identifies coordinated crypto risk transfer whose direction should persist.
mechanism.side: strict four-of-six-or-greater alt final-hour majority sign, confirmed by BTC
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAVDCR uses the cross-sectional dispersion of six log realized variations. Existing cross-alt candidates use return breadth, return correlation, flow, funding, turnover, ticket size, or BTC residuals; none uses compression of alt path-energy dispersion.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC completed six-hour variation strict-prior rank >=0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: hourly false-to-true cross-sectional variation-compression onsets are absent from Gross9

features.aligned_window: 360 exact aligned unique bars_binance interval=1m rows per symbol [D-6h,D)
features.source_valid: finite positive coherent OHLC for every symbol and timestamp; no duplicate, missing, nearest-time join, or imputation
features.symbol_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over 360 minutes, independently strict positive
features.alt_log_variation_dispersion: population standard deviation across the six natural-log alt symbol variations, finite and strict positive
features.dispersion_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2,160 valid hourly decisions, minimum 1,440, current excluded; rank<=0.15
features.final_hour_return: log(last close/first open) over final exact 60 minutes per symbol
features.alt_direction_breadth: at least four of six alt returns share one strict sign; a 3-3 split or zeros without four votes are ineligible
features.btc_confirmation: BTC final-hour return has the same strict sign as the alt majority
features.eligible_state: dispersion compression, BTC variation, alt breadth, and BTC confirmation pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid hour ineligible

clock.decision: D after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal-time entry
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, window, variation, dispersion, breadth, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or gate repair
